listing.name: RTrainSim / openRTS
listing.summary: Drive trains in a native Windows build using the routes and rolling stock from your own RTrainSim installation.

steps.title: Open the start menu
steps.instruction: Extract the ZIP and open openrts_game.exe from the extracted folder. Install the x64 Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable if needed. The project requires a graphics driver with Vulkan or DirectX 12.

steps.title: Choose your RTrainSim folder
steps.instruction: In the start menu, set the folder of your own RTrainSim installation with routes and rolling stock. The menu remembers the folder. Return to openrts_game.exe to choose a route or save, or open Settings to change the folder.

references.title: Keep saves and settings
references.instruction: The default profile is %LOCALAPPDATA%/openRTS. If you use the project’s portable.txt marker, the profile stays beside the program. Open the profile from the project’s Settings and back it up separately. It holds viewer_state.ini, saves grouped by route and RTS_TAPES. The project’s start menu handles updates and lets you turn off checks at startup.

warnings: Portcove does not back up this project’s profile.
